incidents.text: What a goal that is! Ismael Saibari (Morocco) received the ball on the edge of the 18-yard box and spotted the goalkeeper off his line. He set himself up perfectly and lobbed the ball over Alisson and into the net. Brahim Diaz provided the assistance. 0:1.
Vinicius Junior (Brazil) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Bono is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top right corner. The score is 1:1.
Casemiro (Brazil) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
This is a yellow card! Ibanez (Brazil) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Carlo Ancelotti probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Ibanez (Brazil). He is replaced by Danilo.
The game is over for Casemiro (Brazil). Fabinho comes on for the second half.
Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Matheus Cunha (Brazil) replaces Lucas Paqueta.
Igor Thiago goes off the pitch and Luiz Henrique (Brazil) comes on.
Mohamed Ouahbi prepares a substitution. Brahim Diaz is replaced by Chemsdine Talbi (Morocco).
It is time for a substitution. Samir El Mourabet (Morocco) is on for Azzedine Ounahi.
Here comes a substitution. Anass Salah-Eddine (Morocco) is brought on as a substitute for Noussair Mazraoui.
Here is a change. Bilal El Khannouss is going off and Mohamed Ouahbi gives the last tactical orders to Ayoube Amaimouni (Morocco).
Substitution. Bruno Guimaraes is replaced by Danilo Santos (Brazil).
Here comes a substitution. Ismael Saibari is given a rest as he is replaced by Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco).
